Subject: Synapse IO discovery — POC proposal and data asks

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time today. Below is a short post-call recap and a proposed POC playbook so we can move to a kickoff quickly. I tried to capture the pain and success metrics you called out.

Key pain points we heard
- Search relevance drops for domain-specific product codes and feature names (customer examples: SKU-9811, "flux filter" queries).
- Current reranking pipeline misses context from recent docs; manual triage needed for ~20% of tickets.

Success goals for the POC
- Improve precision on KB answers (target +15 NDCG@10 vs baseline).
- Maintain 95th percentile latency under 350ms for single-turn queries in the test environment.
- Demonstrate end-to-end improvement on a representative 50k query sample.

Proposed POC scope (2-week focused run)
1) Use case A: KB retrieval + rerank (evaluate reranker improvement on labelled subset).
2) Use case B: API chat assistant for customer support (sample prompts + slot-filling).
3) Eval plan: baseline -> Redwood model variants (FP16 + 4-bit quant) -> A/B on prompt templates -> report NDCG@10, MRR, latency, token cost.

Owners and what we need from Synapse
- Redwood owners: Sofia (PM/AE lead) + Ben (CS / infra ops) — we will provision test endpoints, run baselines, and deliver eval dashboards.
- Synapse owners: Olivia (product) + Ethan (infra) — please share the sample query set, representative doc snippets, and a service account for read-only access to test data.

Immediate access & compliance asks
1) S3 read-only bucket or CSV export with 50k sample queries + doc snippets (anonymized OK).
2) A scoped service account (time-limited) or signed SFTP credentials we can use for ingestion.
3) Any brief security questionnaire your team requires for a temporary service account (we can route to Security Ops).

Attachments included: synapse_poc_charter_v1.pdf (POC charter template), prompt_sample_set.csv (example prompts).

Proposed timeline
- This week: data handoff + service account + kickoff scheduling.
- Week 1: baseline collection + prompt matrix.
- Week 2: quantized trial + focused eval + review.

I put a placeholder for Wed 5/19 10:30am PT for an official kickoff; if that doesn't work, please suggest an alternate slot.

Links: https://calendly.com/sofia-ivanova/30min | HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/7420

Quick question: will your security team permit a time-limited IAM key for a scoped-read S3 role, or would you prefer we run ingestion from your side?

Thanks,
Sofia
